final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT L.ID AS id, P.SEX AS sex, AVG(L.PT) AS pt, AVG(L.IGA - L.IGM) AS d FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID GROUP BY L.ID, P.SEX), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(d) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.id, s1.sex, s1.pt, s1.d, CASE WHEN s2.m = 0 THEN NULL ELSE s1.d * 1.0 / s2.m END AS r FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL) SELECT sex, AVG(pt), AVG(d), AVG(r) FROM s3 WHERE sex <> '' GROUP BY sex
